acceptance: Threadless findings appear as annotations with the right path, line and severity level on a non-required check run (tests with a fake API).
A permission error leaves the verdict, statuses and gate unchanged (test).
The owner has granted checks: write to each App before enablement; one live PR is observed.
description:
Owner decision 2026-11-13: build the check-run mirror (proposal section 8.8). Findings without a review thread (lines outside the diff) are also published as annotations on a non-required check run, so they show in Files changed and the Checks tab.
Constraints:
- Needs a new `checks: write` App permission. The owner approves it for each App (theseus-review, benchbox-oracle or its renamed successor) before the flag is enabled.
- The check run is never required and never affects the gate.
- Annotations are a mirror: replies and disputes stay in the review body and threads, and the annotation text says so.
- Behind a consumer policy flag, default false.
Guardrails: Theseus merge rule G7 (hosted SHIP + green checks + independent review of the exact final head); markers, fingerprints and the review-protocol record unchanged; verdict reviews and threads never edited after posting unless this item says otherwise; no owner-only actions; shipped through a Theseus release and the BenchBox and Theseus locks.
